[1 media attachment] As someone who was an enterprise backup administrator in a former sysadmin life.. it still blows my mind that I'm still at it with my #homelab and a 16-slot dedicated tape robot.

But this is the investment I make to ensure my data remains my own. It's been quite a journey and it is far from over.
